selection.population: star-forming central galaxies (sSFR within 0.5 dex of the sSFMS), well resolved (M* > 1e8 Msun, 1e9 in SIMBA; gas mass > 10^8.5, 10^9.5 in SIMBA)
selection.warning: z=0 linear least-squares regression of 12+log(O/H) on mu_alpha for the star-forming central galaxies of the simulation, alpha = alpha_min of the minimum-scatter projection. x range is NOT stated by the paper: it is mu_alpha evaluated along the z=0 star-forming main sequence (digitized from the paper's SFMS figure) over the stellar-mass range of the paper's predicted-MZR curve (log M* 8.10-11.20), so it is narrower than the full galaxy scatter in mu_alpha. METALLICITY SCALE: the printed equation of the Illustris/TNG/EAGLE lines is identical in arXiv v1 and v2, but v1 converts the star-forming-gas metal mass fraction to O/H with f_O = 35 per cent while v2 text says f_O = 50 per cent. The equation reproduces the v1 figure (mean offset -0.011 dex) and sits 0.166 dex below the v2 figure (log10(50/35) = 0.155), so it corresponds to f_O = 35 per cent; the v2 text did not update this line. Not a directly tracked oxygen abundance (constant f_O and X scaling of the total metallicity).
